newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BENFICA FAN SENTENCED TO FOUR YEARS AFTER RIVAL'S DEATH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA FAN SENTENCED TO FOUR YEARS AFTER RIVAL'S DEATH.

text.p: A Lisbon court sentenced a Benfica soccer fan on Friday to a four year jail term for firing a flare that killed a rival fan at last year's Portugese Cup final.

Hugo Inacio confessed to the judge that he had fired the flare in the match between Benfica and Sporting which Benfica won 3-1 last May, but he said he had not expected the consequences of his act that caused the death of Sporting fan Rui Mendes.
Inacio, who admitted to having consumed large quantities of alcohol and having smoked hashish at the match, was jailed on a charge of murder by gross negligence.
